def move(s, p, q=None, grip=None, speed=.012, settle=5):
    p=np.asarray(p,float)
    start=np.asarray(s.env.get_ee_pos()).copy()
    q0=np.asarray(s.env.get_ee_quat()).copy()
    if q is None: q=q0
    q=np.asarray(q)
    interp=Slerp([0,1],Rotation.concatenate([rot(q0),rot(q)]))
    n=max(3,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(p-start)/speed)),int(np.ceil((rot(q)*rot(q0).inv()).magnitude()/.12)))
    g=s.targets[7:].copy() if grip is None else np.ones(2)*grip
    for t in np.linspace(0,1,n+1)[1:]:
        if s.done: break
        ik=s.ik(start*(1-t)+p*t,quat(interp(t)))
        s.step(np.r_[ik['joint_positions'],g])
    hold(s,settle)
    print('move',p,'actual',s.env.get_ee_pos(),'steps',len(s.actions),'done',s.done,flush=True)
